Completed.root: Fresh connected Survival player receives the native tick advancement.
Completed.iron_has_a_darker_side: Pick up an iron ingot and synchronize the native inventory screen.
Completed.recipes/unlock: The same real iron pickup unlocks the mod's recipes.
Completed.rusty_business: Drop a nail into water and wait for the complete configured rust duration.
Completed.rusty_hook: Drop fishing rods into water, allow native salvage rolls, and pick up a recovered hook.
Completed.glove_protection: Equip gloves by right-clicking and withstand real rusty zombie melee attacks until one exposure is prevented.
Completed.shield_protection: Raise a Tetanus Protection shield and block an actual enchanted zombie melee attack.
Completed.tetanized_mob: Use Rust on an iron golem until a real conversion roll succeeds.
Completed.rusty_guardian: The same successful, causal iron-golem conversion awards its specific advancement.
Completed.strange_meat: Kill an egg-spawned Tetanized cow with a real player attack and pick up its infected meat.
Completed.clean_bill_of_health: Apply a veterinary kit to a second egg-spawned Tetanized cow.
Completed.nice_one: Kill an egg-spawned Tetanized Wither with a Creative-prepared test sword using the native attack method.
Completed.clinic: Place a two-block Medicine Cabinet through the Survival block-item interaction.
Completed.trap_reset: A cow walks into a placed trap; use its reset tool through the native block interaction.
Completed.rust_arrows: Take a real 64-arrow/Rust smithing result through the native output slot.
Completed.medic: Open a medic's actual merchant menu, supply its generated barter inputs, and take its output.
Completed.supply_run: Sneak-interact with that medic holding its requested daily supply delivery.
Completed.spear: Right-click a spear at a live indexed cow and land its actual raycast thrust.
Completed.infected: Contract Tetanus from an actual rusty zombie injury or a real timed Tetanus potion.
Completed.why_did_i_eat_that: Eat raw infected meat using the real item-use timer.
Completed.rabies: Eat raw Rabid Meat using the real item-use timer.
Completed.rabies_cured: Drink Rabies Cure after the raw-meat infection.
Completed.lockjaw_sonata: Drink a Lockjaw Sonata potion using the real item-use timer.
Completed.antitoxin: Drink antitoxin while Tetanus and Lockjaw are active.
Completed.vaccinated: Drink a vaccine using the real item-use timer.
Completed.beacon_placed: Place the Tetanized Beacon with its BlockItem.
Completed.beacon_full: Build its complete rusty-iron pyramid, pay Netherite in the native menu, and wait for real beacon ticks.
Completed.why_did_i_do_that: Throw a rusty nail upward and catch its returning real projectile with a one-health test player.

Retired.variant_egg: Creative-only Bad Egg removed at the owner's request; hidden ID preserved solely for old saves. Actual variant eggs were still exercised.
